description: VoiceMode heard ride-along: after a tool call, print what VoiceMode heard since this session last looked (heard_YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl past the session's cursor), within a token budget. Opt-in: `voicemode claude hooks add heard`; a bare `hooks add` does not install it. Silent when nothing is new; never blocks; never claims a line. VOICEMODE_HEARD_HOOK=off silences it per session.
